plugins.name: google-workspace-mcp
plugins.description: Multi-account, token-efficient MCP for Gmail + Calendar + Drive + Docs + Sheets. OAuth multiple mailboxes (work + personal + co-founder), compact list/search shapes with opt-in bodies, OS keyring-backed refresh tokens (macOS, Windows and Linux). 61 tools across account management, Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, and Sheets.
